neighbours.label: words meaning 'spread throughout' (pervasive, pervade, permeate, widespread)
fire: A sense of distrust is pervasive in the department.
The scent of pine permeates the entire valley in spring.
Advertising has become pervasive in modern sports.
A quiet sadness pervades the whole novel.
There was widespread anger over the new tax.
Moisture had permeated the walls of the basement.
Poverty remains pervasive in the rural districts.
The rumour caused widespread panic among investors.
quiet: A sense of distrust is visible in the department.
The scent of pine reaches the edge of the valley in spring.
Advertising has become expensive in modern sports.
A quiet sadness marks the ending of the novel.
There was some anger over the new tax.
Moisture had damaged the walls of the basement.
Poverty remains serious in the rural districts.
The rumour caused brief panic among investors.
